$comment: Editor support for datagen ruleset authoring. This is what turns ruleset/modules/*.json
from 'a wall of numbers you have to already understand' into a guided surface:
• Ctrl/Cmd+Space at the top level lists the blocks (membership, events, committees…)
• hovering any key explains what it is, in prose
• a share of 45, a tolerance of 0, an arrow with no evidence: red squiggle as you type
The same schema is executed in the suite (node cli/check-ruleset-schema.mjs), so what the
editor promises and what the build enforces cannot drift apart.
